dedupe_keys.name: arpa piemonte valutazione teorica del campo elettrico da impianti per telecomunicazione

description: Arpa Piemonte - Valutazione teorica del campo elettrico da impianti per telecomunicazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.arpa.piemonte.it. Estimate of the electric field produced in total by telecommunications installations with an authorisation to transmit on the regional territory obtained from the theoretical evaluation of each individual plant, according to the free space and distant field model. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "ARPA Piemonte — Theoretical evaluation of the electric field from telecommunications systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include stima campo elettrico, telefonia mobile, RNDT, Impianti telecomunicazione. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
